## Data Cleaning

```{r}
library(caret)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)

heart_data <- read.csv("heart_original.csv")

head(heart_data)
dim(heart_data)
```

## Remove Duplicates

```{r}
original_rows <- nrow(heart_data)

heart_data <- unique(heart_data)

cleaned_rows <- nrow(heart_data)

original_rows
cleaned_rows

original_rows - cleaned_rows

write.csv(heart_data, "heart_cleaned.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

## Change Target to Factor

```{r}
heart_data$target <- factor(
  heart_data$target,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  labels = c("No_Disease", "Disease")
)

table(heart_data$target)
```
## Data Splitting

```{r}
set.seed(123)

train_index <- createDataPartition(
  heart_data$target,
  p = 0.80,
  list = FALSE
)

train_data <- heart_data[train_index, ]
test_data <- heart_data[-train_index, ]

nrow(train_data)
nrow(test_data)

table(train_data$target)
table(test_data$target)
```

## Save as CSV

```{r}
write.csv(train_data, "train_data.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(test_data, "test_data.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```
          
## 10-Fold Cross-Validation
```{r}
cv_settings <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 10
)

tuned_tree <- train(
  target ~ .,
  data = train_data,
  method = "rpart",
  trControl = cv_settings,
  tuneLength = 10
)
```
## Accuracy vs.CP
```{r}
plot(tuned_tree,
     main = "Accuracy vs. Complexity Parameter")
```

## Final Decision Tree
```{r}
rpart.plot(tuned_tree$finalModel)
```
Explanation in progress...

## Testing Data
```{r}
predictions<- predict(tuned_tree, newdata = test_data)
```
## Confusion Matrix
```{r}
confusion_table<- table(Actual = test_data$target, Predicted = predictions)
print("--- Test Set Confusion Matrix Table ---")
print(confusion_table)
```
## Test Accuracy
```{r}
correct_counts<- sum(diag(confusion_table))
total_counts<- sum(confusion_table)
test_accuracy<- correct_counts/total_counts
cat("\nFinal Calculated Test Accuracy Rate:", round(test_accuracy*100,2), "%\n")
```
## Sensitivity & Specificity
Sensitivity = TP/(TP+FN) = 28/(28+4) = 0.875
Specificity = TN/(TN+FP) = 15/(15+12) = 0.556
